definitions.title: Stokes' Theorem
definitions.statement: The circulation of a continuously differentiable vector field F around the oriented boundary curve C of an oriented surface S equals the flux of the curl of F through S.
conditions: S is an oriented piecewise-smooth surface
C is boundary curve oriented by right-hand rule with respect to n
definitions.explanation: Extends Green's Theorem to arbitrary curved two-dimensional surfaces embedded in three-dimensional space.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Circulation along a closed loop depends only on the boundary curve, allowing replacement of complex surfaces with simpler ones sharing the same boundary.

definitions.title: Curl Vector and Local Rotation
definitions.statement: The component of curl F along unit normal n represents the limiting circulation density per unit area in the plane orthogonal to n.
conditions: Limit taken as area of loop shrinks to zero around point
definitions.explanation: A miniature paddle wheel placed in fluid flow rotates with maximum angular speed when its axis is aligned with curl F.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Curl measures microscopic fluid vorticity and field rotation.
